name: Auto Complete
description: Auto-jump bot plus noclip, with pause-menu toggles and built-in safe mode.

bot.name: Auto Jump Bot
bot.description: When ON, the bot plays by itself: it reads obstacles ahead and jumps/flies for every game mode (cube, ship, ball, UFO, wave, robot, spider, swing). Not perfect on very hard levels; combine with Noclip so it never dies. Platformer levels are not supported.

enabled.name: Noclip
enabled.description: When ON, the player cannot die. Combined with the bot, every level reaches 100%.

pause-button.name: Show Pause Menu Toggles
pause-button.description: Show Bot and Noclip checkboxes in the pause menu.
